# Chargeback Analysis: Consumer Disputes and Fraud drove holiday period increases

Consumer Disputes and Fraud reason categories drove disputes during the Nov 2025-Jan 2026 holiday period, with Consumer Disputes up 59% in volume and Fraud up 60% versus Aug-Oct 2025.

| Reason Category | Disputes (avg/mo) | Disputed $ | Win Rate | Friendly Fraud Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Consumer Disputes | 333 [F1] | $619K [F1] | 55.6% [F1] | 0.0% [F1] |
| Fraud | 201 [F3] | $375K [F3] | 32.8% [F3] | 100.0% [F3] |
| Processing Errors | 40 [F5] | $72K [F5] | 50.0% [F5] | 0.0% [F5] |

- **Consumer Disputes** surged from 210 [F2] to 333 disputes/month [F1] (59% increase) and from $371K [F2] to $619K [F1] (67% increase) during the holiday period; win rate improved from 52.4% [F2] to 55.6% [F1] for resolved disputes only
- **Fraud** disputes increased from 126 [F4] to 201/month [F3] (60% increase) with disputed dollars rising from $231K [F4] to $375K [F3] (62% increase); all disputes flagged as friendly fraud [F3, F4] with win rate declining from 35.2% [F4] to 32.8% [F3] for resolved disputes only
- **Processing Errors** rose from 26 [F6] to 40 disputes/month [F5] (54% increase) and $50K [F6] to $72K [F5] (44% increase); win rate at 50.0% [F5] versus 53.8% [F6] for resolved disputes only

## Data Coverage
Nov 2025-Jan 2026 vs Aug-Oct 2025 comparison. CFPB complaint benchmarks: 5,110/month [F1, F3, F5] and 4,676/month [F2, F4, F6] respectively (market-wide figures, not summed).
